# Egg Smash Adventures

> A free, ad-free egg-smashing collection game for the browser and Android. You tap eggs with a hammer, win gold and prizes, and fill an album of 400 collectible items across 6 monkey worlds and 59 stages. It is an independent revival of the 2008 Facebook egg-breaking genre, built as a progressive web app with an Android build on Google Play.

Canonical site: https://www.eggbreakeradventure.com/
Google Play: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.eggbreakeradventures.app
Also playable on itch.io: https://yotamjac.itch.io/egg-smash-adventures
Developer: YotJac (Yotam Jacob). Contact details are on the About page.

Key facts
- Free to play, no ads, no energy paywall. Optional cosmetic in-app purchases on Android only.
- Hammers are the action resource: they regenerate over time, and the maximum grows as stages are completed.
- 7 egg tiers (normal, crystal, ruby, black, century and more) with different prize tables.
- 6 monkey companions, each with its own world of stages and a passive bonus.
- Hats and special hammers with upgradeable mastery levels.
- Daily and weekly quests, trophies, an Auto-Smasher for idle play, and "The Egg" side mode.
- Works offline after the first load (service worker). Cloud save through Google sign-in is optional.
- Runs in any modern mobile or desktop browser; the Android app needs Android 6.0 or newer.
